skills.name: Heal - Fire Stance - Fire

fx.raw: Restore all party members' HP +10% \ 20% \ 30% \ 40%

skills.desc:
When in Raging Fire Stance:
* Restore all party members' HP +10% \ 20% \ 30% \ 40%
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Fire type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
* Equipment and some effects multiply healing.
